about: Glue-shape cases for tests/wasm_glue_shape.mjs. Each case applies a named transform to the REAL built glue (insimul.mjs) and binary (insimul.wasm) and states the verdict docs/consuming.md's 'fetched, not inlined' promise requires. 'rules' lists, in order, the rules (name, payload, size) that must fire. Replay: node tests/wasm_glue_shape.mjs <build-wasm>/insimul.mjs --cases tests/wasm-glue-shape/cases.json (the wasm_glue_shape ctest).

cases.why: The glue as linked by cmake/wasm.cmake fetches the sibling binary.
Emscripten 3.1.50-4.0.2 emit the bare data-URI prefix in every build (URIUtils.js); it must not read as an inlined binary.
A glue that never names insimul.wasm has no sibling file to fetch.
A data URI that carries base64 data is an inlined payload even when the glue stays small.
SINGLE_FILE from Emscripten 4.0.18 embeds the binary as a raw string: no data URI, so only size sees it.
A glue that grew to 0.45x the binary (no payload, name kept) is still a fetching glue: the size rule fires at 0.5.
At 0.55x the binary a glue has room for an inlined payload, whatever its encoding.
SINGLE_FILE up to 4.0.17 puts a base64 data URI where the file name was.
